models.name: facebook_ads__ad_report
models.description: Each record represents the daily performance of a Facebook ad. Use the most recent version of the account, ad, campaign, and ad set to ensure the most up-to-date data if there are multiple versions for the same account, ad, campaign, or ad set.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: The date of the performance.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The ID of the related account.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: The name of the related account.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.description: The ID of the related campaign.

columns.name: campaign_name
columns.description: The name of the related campaign.

columns.name: ad_set_id
columns.description: The ID of the related ad set.

columns.name: ad_set_name
columns.description: The name of the related ad set.

columns.name: ad_id
columns.description: The ID of the ad.

columns.name: ad_name
columns.description: The name of the ad.

columns.name: clicks
columns.description: The number of clicks the ad had on the given day.

columns.name: impressions
columns.description: The number of impressions the ad had on the given day.

columns.name: spend
columns.description: The spend on the ad in the given day.

columns.name: conversions
columns.description: Total number of conversions using the default attribution window on the given day. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.

columns.name: conversions_value
columns.description: Total monetary of conversions using the default attribution window on the given day. Set to 0 if the value is NULL.
